title: To my 8th grade teacher who gave us a C on 1st use of "to be" and failed us on 2nd I salute you. While lesson may not ring true carries racial overton
summary: To my 8th grade teacher who gave us a C on 1st use of "to be" and failed us on 2nd I salute you. While lesson may not ring true carries racial overtones your fascist hatred for passive verbs strengthened my writing 4eva. And that's how it is. #literacies
author: Greg McVerry
